scope: Private workspace state after an authoritative session owner change
beforeEvidence: On 23acdd1, the real browser session changed to the second synthetic owner while the settings form still contained the first owner's unsaved school

implementation.boundary: A single session observer wraps the per-user WorkspaceContent and ConfirmProvider; the provider is keyed by authenticated user ID
implementation.sameOwner: A changed session object or temporary lookup error does not reset the current user's form
implementation.metadataReads: Workspace profile/jobs share an AbortController; history/library abort obsolete fetches on effect cleanup
implementation.dialogs: Unmount resolves pending confirmations as false

verification.chromium: Nine-case suite plus the pending-account-deletion case: all ten passed
verification.webkit: Nine-case suite plus the pending-account-deletion case: all ten passed
verification.draftContents: Additional Chromium checks read both saved draft bodies; both include the private edit and return 404 to the second owner. The WebKit suite also checks draft contents
verification.runtimeRestored: Verification disabled, normal local Mailpit configuration restored

sessionReadBudgetObservation.originalRun: Two UI cases failed after real /api/auth/get-session HTTP 429 responses; Lite signup itself returned 200
sessionReadBudgetObservation.sdk: Better Auth 1.7.10 updates lastRequest on accepted reads; the native counter resets after an idle window
sessionReadBudgetObservation.remaining: A sustained low-rate shared-IP regression and a replenishing session-read budget still need implementation

remoteCI.newChangeFailure: Delayed-profile case timed out waiting for HTTP 200 from get-session after cross-tab notification; exact response status was not retained in the CI log
remoteCI.followUp: The full run with unchanged workspace-session scenarios and the replenishing read budget passed. The original timeout still has no retained response status, so its exact cause is not asserted

limits: The boundary follows authoritative session identity, not raw cookie changes before session lookup finishes
This implementation covers the main React workspace; cross-tab identity handling in Lite still needs a separate audit
Operations already committed on the server are not rolled back; post-await actions and expected-owner mutation fencing require a separate audit
Local unsaved settings are cleared on a genuine account change; only acknowledged server editor drafts are proven retained
Physical legacy PCs and public hosting remain unverified
No paid resources, public deployment or real provider sign-ins were performed
